Sizes.note: default (h-5 w-10) next to compact (h-5 w-8) with captions — the track-width difference and the matching thumb travel are both clearly visible.

States.note: on / off / on-disabled / off-disabled. Checked tracks paint bg-primary with the thumb at the right stop, unchecked paint bg-input; the disabled pair renders at 50% opacity. Full state axis in one cell.

WithLabel.note: Switch paired with a real Label via id/htmlFor — the standard labelled-control anatomy, with both an on and an off row.

InSettingsRows.note: The switch in its most common home: right-aligned control inside SettingsRows, including the compact size on the description-less row. Alignment and hairline dividers all correct.
